Stream emits error event when a page fails mid-crawl, but other pages succeed

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawlStream, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxConcurrent: 1, maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawlStream(engine, url);
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
